rules.statement: The customary laws of the Hindus of India have not been introduced into Ceylon, and a customary law of one country may be observed by a class or community in another country so long as it develops into a custom having the force of law in the latter country.
rules.supporting_quote: A customary law of one country may be observed by a class or community in another country so long as to let it develop into a custom having the force of law in the latter country, but it in this case there is no proof of any such local custom or of any customary or other law of India to support the defendant's claim.
